title: Colts MUST beat winless Titans; Can Indy unlock Jonathan Taylor?
text: The Athletic's James Boyd and 107.5 The Fan's Caleb Zuver preview the Indianapolis Colts' upcoming home game against the winless Tennessee Titans. If the Colts somehow lose, jobs should be lost as well. Boyd and Zuver also explore how Indy can get Jonathan Taylor back on track. The star running back has failed to reach 100 rushing yards in 12 straight games, the second-longest drought of his career. Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company.
